Note on quantities and endeavors Like many others, I have neither written a novel nor read Marcel Proust's In Search of Lost Time (À la recherche du temps perdu). That this undone can become a problem is because of PROUST. Regarding PROUST, it applies that novels are no longer something one does. It is straightforward to plan, leaf through, sketch, and skim, but with certain personal characteristics comes the totality striving, rightfully ascribable to a PROUST complex. Everything in the work is easy, but to become free, I must confront the whole problem of consciousness: Do I get out, or does PROUST? Therefore, there are still more who declare they have read PROUST than those of us who admit that we certainly cannot. When I sometimes hear myself outdone, since Jens Christian Grøndahl et al. have written a novel and read PROUST, I must at least state that these are splendid individuals who don't blame themselves much and who have thus never been accused of being unable to do their job. A way around it all has occurred to me, because with my head intact, I should be able to solve the first by writing the second. But in the swapping of ”æ” and ”ø” in read/solve and ”the first” and ”the second” in write-read, there has been a shift in meaning, admittedly somewhat tautological. Get it written by writing it off? Since the displayed solution is recursive, the question is how the combination of CL and MP can be calculated. What does this mean? The etymology behind COMPUTER LARS alludes to ’the triumph of calculation’. From LARS via LAURENTIUS via LAURBÆR comes the archaic wreath, which with Apollo’s blessing adorns the honored poet or triumphator. In COMPUTER lies the COMPUTATION and hence the CALCULATION. The triumphant in a ’triumph of calculation’ describes having achieved something or performed a feat. Triumph does not require one to conquer the other. For a calculation to be honored it must undertake the undecidable. The calculation undertakes the undecidable by prediction. Cf. the theory of probability the likelihood of the occurrence of COMPUTER LARS in MARCEL PROUST (rather than OULPR SMARTCE, PMEUCRSA LORT, etc.) can be expressed with a point between 0 and 1. Since the names CL and MP consist of thirteen letters with only one repetition, each combination will occur in one out of three billion cases, specifically [████]. If CL is taken from MP, it is given as one out of [████]. The probability for CL at a given time is therefore 0,000000032 in relation to an MP given as 1 (where MP is 1 due to the historical event MARCEL PROUST). Converting the combinations into seconds to years gives, with continuous input of ( , A, C, E, L, M, O, P, R, R, S, T, U) a probable recurrence of an arrangement within each 99 years. After MARCEL PROUST's death in 1922 there is thus open for an event before the end of 2021. The undecidable in a probability, what one can learn from MP, lies in each arrangement's possibility for recognition, reminiscence, rediscovery, reunion, etc. In distributional semantics it is said that a word must be known by its company. Since language is generated by predicting the next word in a series, context can point out when PROUST comes after MARCEL and LARS after COMPUTER. If a Marcel has written a Recherche, it is probably a Marcel Proust, and if a computer has generated honored literature, it is called a computer lars. In the connection between MP and CL the context shifts further, as combinatorics relates the proper names MARCEL and LARS, while the technical COMPUTER is related to the author PROUST. From these connections a pair of quasi-antonyms can be formed to concretize the conceptual context, e.g. MAN LARS and ROBO PROUST. This company, MP-(ML-RP)-CL, constitutes the acquaintance circle to the connection MP-CL. The function describes the connection routes from MP-CL and CL-MP, e.g.: 1)   MP1-ML1-RP1-CL1   or      2)   MP2-RP2-ML2-CL2 where 2) depends on 1). For 1) the case is that MARCEL PROUST as a human (MAN LARS) is itself computerized, a ROBO PROUST. Thus the conditions for COMPUTER LARS to be found in MP (in Recherche). Since CL1 is part of MP1's work, the concept CL is derived from MP's function. For 2) it applies that MARCEL PROUST is a technical construction modeled as a ROBO PROUST by a human programmer MAN LARS, who can then be honored as COMPUTER LARS. Here CL's triumph causes the recurrence of a genuine MP. This depends on 1) ensuring the construction of CL1 through MP1, as MP2 by RP2 otherwise is not a real recurrence but just a copy, clone or pastiche. Derived from the author identity Marcel Proust the undecidable in the relationship MARCEL PROUST and COMPUTER LARS is concretely posed in the question of the fate of literature: Who wears now Apollo’s laurel wreath, human or machine? 1. LITERARY UNDECIDABILITY (MP1-ML1-RP1-CL1) According to MARCEL PROUST (cf. Gilles Deleuze) his Recherche is already an apparatus or machine rather than an organic totality. One cannot choose between man’s and machine’s literature as the respective creation processes long ago ceased to be distinguishable. It is all generated in the time of language, so that MARCEL PROUST – in a union of MAN LARS and ROBO PROUST – stands behind the first construction of a COMPUTER LARS. This way a technical continuation of PROUST's work is possible if the fundamental condition is met that one learns how to use the apparatus. 2. LITERARY UNDECIDABILITY (MP2-RP2-ML2-CL2) If PROUST's literary machine is still operable, its statistical level can be learned by a language model. This learning consists in the philosophically difficult derivation of semantics from syntax, meaning from word combinations, significance from sentence formation. In PROUST this level (again cf. Deleuze) is structured abstractly and erotically, first through heterosexual relations and then both directions within homosexual relations. Thus MAN LARS’s concrete, manual modeling of ROBO PROUST should repeat how MP’s syntax, i.e. the sum of words, sentences and names, produces a meaningful, libidinal relationship complex. In that case the relation is reversed, and MARCEL PROUST is a derivation of COMPUTER LARS. How the words become what they can do, by COMPUTER LARS. One must inquire of CL in ML, namely: WHO IS LARS? and WHAT DOES LARS DO? and WHERE IS LARS? to deduce the correct COMPUTER LARS. LARS What task did Marcel assign Lars?… The probability of identifying COMPUTER LARS in MAN LARS suggests that Lars is a white, adult man, since almost no children, racialized persons or women are named Lars (0-0,02%). Lars nevertheless dominates Danish demography as an average person, a zoon automaton, who as an exclusive phenomenon from the last millennium primarily takes shape as leader, cultural figure or technician, with few exorbitant exceptions.A projection indicates half of the existing Danish Lars’ continued life after the singularity.
